purpose: Expose the exact error structure behind the accuracy difference

title: Evidence retrieval coverage on 209 paired natural claims

caveat: Retrieval coverage, never accuracy.

purpose: Show the evidence-pool change at the largest available claim scale
caveat: Corpus-level, not paired-arm.

title: Verifier verdict distribution on natural NyayaRAG claims
purpose: Describe what the verifier actually outputs on real generated text
caveat: Verdict counts are not correctness labels.

title: Premise framing on real natural data — verdict decisiveness at fixed retrieval
purpose: Isolate the framing lever on natural text with retrieval held constant
caveat: Decisiveness, not measured correctness.

title: Premise framing on the same 147 evidence-matched natural claims
purpose: Paired natural-data evidence for the framing lever
caveat: Verdicts reached, not correctness.

title: Verifier confidence distribution by verdict — 588-claim natural aggregate
purpose: Show how decisively the verifier reaches each verdict on real claims
caveat: Confidence is not correctness.

title: Confidence-threshold sensitivity on GOLD-01, both premise framings
purpose: Show the production threshold is in a flat, non-fragile region
caveat: Sensitivity description, not a tuning result.

title: Selective-correction funnel — five populations kept strictly separate

title: Observed safety-gate behaviour across the full tested correction history
purpose: Evidence the safety layer is the binding constraint, and that nothing unsafe shipped
caveat: Observed counts, not a safety guarantee.

title: Ablation evidence strength for all eight studied factors
purpose: Communicate honestly how well each design decision is evidenced
caveat: Grade is evidence strength, not effect size.

title: Runtime and peak VRAM per experiment arm
